### `app/[locale]/dashboard/revenue/page.tsx:74` — **INFO A9: blue outside the hyperlink scope (v3)**

```
period === p ? "bg-s-accent text-white" : "text-s-ink-2 hover:text-s-ink",
```

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). _LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). ```

```

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

```

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

```

```

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

_LOCKFILE §1.5 v3 (2026-06-11): blue `s-accent` is the HYPERLINK color — CORRECT only on text that reads as an <a href> inside prose (review counts "(12)", inline body links, Mehr lesen, the one Passwort vergessen, checkout Ändern jump-links) plus locked system states (focus ring / Spinner / input focus / §13.2 stepper discs). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). WRONG on see-all / active tabs / secondary & ghost buttons / icon tints (→ INK + affordance: chevron / weight / position), on NON-interactive text — eyebrows, body, prices, headings (→ ink/grey) — and as a FILLED primary CTA (→ bg-s-ink). Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._

Squint test: ~3 blue strings max per viewport, 0-1 on forms._
